card.name: Adjectives before medical nouns
card.fires_on: Adjectives or word beginnings that sit just before a technical medical noun, such as clinical, systemic, theoretical, vascular and organic. The next word is usually a noun like trials, exposure or frameworks.

modes.label: Modifier before noun
modes.description: A scientific adjective that opens a noun phrase and is followed by a term like trials or exposure.
modes.example: the<< systemic>> exposure of drugs metabolized by CYP

modes.label: Partway through a term
modes.description: A piece of a longer medical word or hyphenated term that still needs its ending.
modes.example: ically Superv<<ised>> Withdrawal After a Period of Maintenance Treatment
